narrative:
## Handover Summary — NII & Fee Income Planning

Income validated across six portfolios, sixteen products and six regions. The NII & Margin Agent generated 15 proposals; 11 were accepted.

## Key Decisions
• Specialist Mortgages margin after FTP reset for the 2026 cuts (−£4.9M)
• Reserve-account and FTP mismatch in the central book (−£1.8M)
• Bridging completions raised to the ML pipeline forecast (+£1.1M)
• Easy access deposit beta proposal (0.60 → 0.68) sent to ALCO

## Recommendation for Impairment & Cost of Risk
Development finance balances are above plan because sales are slow in the South East — re-run stage 2 before the forecast is locked.
